transform.provenance: Local equirectangular approximation shared by OSM geometry and roads; origin near centre of OSM university way 395256540, not surveyed control

limitations: Synthetic passenger-car demand; not an observed Patiala traffic replay.
Two-wheelers, auto-rickshaws, pedestrians and heterogeneous lane behaviour are not calibrated.
Historical official traffic counts are context only; no current OD matrix or measured signal timings.
